findings.current: The iron balls came hurtling across a distance of more than two hundred yards
findings.defect: Two hundred jang is roughly six hundred meters, not two hundred yards.
findings.rationale: The conversion substantially shortens the stated firing distance.
findings.replacement: The iron balls came hurtling across more than six hundred yards
findings.source: 이백여 장의 거리를 격하고 쇄도한 쇳덩이들이

findings.current: Taishan caught a fish that had been swept all the way onto the deck in the spray. He looked dejected.
findings.defect: The draft makes the fish sound as though it had reached the deck; Taishan snatches it out of the air while it is flying toward the deck.
findings.rationale: 허공에서 잡아챈 specifies where and how he catches the fish.
findings.replacement: Taishan snatched a fish out of the air as the blast sent it flying toward the deck. He looked dejected.
findings.source: 그 여파에 휘말려 재수 없게 갑판까지 날아온 생선을 허공에서 잡아챈 태산이 울상을 지었다.

findings.defect: The inclusive “let’s” makes Jin part of the effort, though he has just said the others can stop the cannonballs without him.
findings.rationale: The line prompts the companions serving as his ‘human shields’ to act.

findings.current: Every military vessel had poured out cannonballs by the hundreds.
findings.defect: The draft assigns hundreds of shots to each vessel rather than hundreds across all the vessels combined.
findings.rationale: 모든 군선에서 퍼부은 대포알만 족히 수백 발 counts the collective barrage.
findings.replacement: Together, the military vessels had fired hundreds of cannonballs by now.
findings.source: 지금까지 모든 군선에서 퍼부은 대포알만 족히 수백 발은 된다.

findings.current: “Cease your attack! Cease it! I’m ordering you, as a relative of His Majesty the Emperor!”
findings.defect: Ju Wongong’s self-correction from an imperial command to an invented imperial-family command is lost, as is his boast that he is related to the Emperor in the eighth degree.
findings.rationale: 황명, 아니 황족명 is the distinction Jin questions in the next line; 팔촌 states the precise, distant kinship Ju invokes.
findings.replacement: “Cease fire! Cease! This is an imperial command—no, an imperial-family command, issued by me as His Majesty the Emperor’s eighth-degree relative!”
findings.source: “공격 중지! 중지잇! 이건 황명, 아니 황상 폐하의 팔촌 되는 몸으로서 내리는 황족명이다!”

summary: The draft preserves the scene overall, but changes a distance and a cannonball count, blurs one physical action, shifts an order to the group into a shared intention, and omits Ju Wongong’s stated kinship.
